skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; every transferable lesson here is proposed as a commit candidate instead of written into the ledger.
A gene-replacement lesson from another gene is not a WWOX therapeutic hypothesis; forging one would convert a stated transfer limit into a lead.
No small molecule with a SMILES is proposed, so the BLOCK-1 ADMET gate has nothing to triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate.
The triples are published for a blind auditor; a reader cannot audit their own locators.

entries.proposition: Partial restoration of the complex was enough to correct the cargo phenotype in cells.
entries.snippet: restoration of AP4B1 protein levels via gene replacement approaches was sufficient to restore the AP-4 complex

entries.proposition: The immunogenicity study was run in wild-type animals, which already express the orthologue.
entries.snippet: Safety studies in WT mice included study 1: ELISpot reactivity

entries.proposition: Those animals were dosed in the first days of life, when tolerance is most readily induced.
entries.snippet: Wild-type mice C57BL/6 (P1-3) were administered control vector

entries.proposition: The only immune assay measures T-cell interferon release; no antibody assay is reported.
entries.snippet: This assay detects INF-γ secretion from activated T cells in response to a stimulant

entries.proposition: Structural endpoints were rescued only by neonatal treatment while motor endpoints were rescued at both ages.
entries.snippet: In contrast to treatment of neonates, treatment in adults did not show any significant improvement

entries.proposition: Adult treatment still rescued motor function despite leaving the anatomy unchanged.
entries.snippet: significant functional recovery of motor phenotypes was observed

entries.proposition: The human dose was derived by scaling to cerebrospinal-fluid volume on regulatory advice.
entries.snippet: FDA guidance to us was to scale up human dosing by cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) volume

entries.proposition: A specific human dose is proposed for a four-year-old from the primate high dose.
entries.snippet: corresponds to a human dose of 4

entries.proposition: Treatment-related microscopic nerve and spinal-cord findings were dose- and time-dependent.
entries.snippet: These treatment-related microscopic findings displayed a dose and time dependence in the severity and incidence of histopathological findings

entries.proposition: A strong ubiquitous promoter cannot always be used because of the packaging limit.
entries.snippet: this promoter combined with larger transgene lengths often exceeds the limits of AAV9 packaging capacity

entries.proposition: One animal that received the therapeutic vector died unexplained during the one-year study.
entries.snippet: There was one unexplained death at 80 days post-treatment

entries.proposition: A treatment-associated white-cell rise occurred in the therapeutic arm and resolved by one year.
entries.snippet: Elevation in white blood cell count (WBC) was observed in the ICM cohort treated with AAV9/CBh-hAP4B1
